item.title: OpenClaw Config File: Main Keys and Defaults (2026)
item.description:
OpenClaw reads its settings from ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json. The file is JSON5, and every field is optional. Leave a field out and OpenClaw uses its built-in default.

This page lists the top-level sections and the keys people change most. Defaults come from OpenClaw’s configuration docs, read on 2026-11-25. The docs spread the full key list over about 20 subpages, so this page is not the full list. The reference page of the docs says the same: it points to the subpage for each area.

item.title: Hermes Agent config.yaml Reference: Main Sections and Keys (2026)
item.description:
Hermes Agent keeps its settings in ~/.hermes/config.yaml. Secrets (API keys, bot tokens) go in ~/.hermes/.env. The config file wins for every non-secret setting when both are set.

This page lists the main sections and the keys people change most. The values are the ones in Hermes’s own example file, read on 2026-11-24. The file has 28 top-level sections and many more child keys. The first table lists all 28 sections. The key table covers only the main child keys, not the full list.
